chunks: So, therefore, remember Me, and I shall remember you; and give thanks and do not be ungrateful.
ai.seo_question: What is the reciprocal promise between God and believers regarding remembrance and gratitude?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as establishing a covenantal reciprocity where human dhikr (remembrance) invites divine rahmah (mercy) and acceptance. The command to 'be grateful' (ashkuru li) is viewed not merely as an emotional state but as an active adherence to divine will, while 'do not be ungrateful' (la takfurun) warns against the spiritual stagnation that leads to deviation from the path of the Ahl al-Bayt.
